quest.title: The Artist By the Moon's Side (III)
quest.description: The Damselette is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Isn't that Maalaus? Has she been out gathering inspiration, again?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Yes. But the little one has been like this ever since she came back... As if lost in thought.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, maybe the theme this time is super profound... Y'know, like when a great artist realizes some fundamental truth about the world.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, Maalaus has given us a whole bunch of paintings. We could hold an entire exhibition at this rate!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon can't wait to tell everyone all about our little painter's rise to artistic stardom! Ah, but we'd need Columbina's permission first, of course.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hm? Why is that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, 'cause they're nearly all paintings of you.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Oh... It's okay, I don't mind. It sounds intriguing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, seems like Maalaus has decided what to draw! Quick, let's see what kind of paint we've got.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This time... Let's go for deep and tranquil colors!

talks.objective: Give the kuuhenki some objects with vivid colors

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Deep, tranquil colors...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, these should do. What do you think, Maalaus?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, looks like a happy kuuhenki to Paimon! Hehe, wonder what kind of painting we'll get this time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, is it done already?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maalaus seems a little sad. Is it because of the painting? Let's take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay so, it's Columbina... taking a walk under the moonlight and gazing up at the night sky.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah... I must be looking at the true moon beyond the false sky. I used to take midnight walks like that all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Used to...? Oh, right...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Columbina is pretty much confined to this garden, now... even though Nod-Krai is where she was born...)

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Yes, I would gaze at the sky and wonder... What really lies up there on the true Frost Moon?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's just like here, filled with lots of little animals...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Or perhaps... there's nothing there at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...

choices.text: You could always take a few up there with you?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: But... Since the moon lies beyond the false sky, that's one adventure I would rather not risk taking them on...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (One is a "home" where she isn't even free to move around... the other is a "home" she knows nothing about...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maalaus and the other kuuhenki are really gonna miss you...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: And I will miss them too.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: But in the end, this is a journey that only I can make... and the answer at the end of it is mine alone to seek.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: And who knows? Whatever that answer turns out to be... Perhaps it will be something beautiful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Well... We'll just have to come visit you, then! With Maalaus!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Alright. We could hold that art exhibition on the moon, perhaps.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, great idea! It's a promise!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: I hope so, I truly do...

choices.text: There could be other cute creatures up there...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: And I hope... if there are, the creatures would welcome the sudden and unexpected return of their "Goddess."

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: What is there... up on the moon...
